basic_info.description:
AVAILABLE NOW with 1 week notice

This spacious and beautifully remodeled home combines the details, craftmanship and
charm of the period it was built, along with modern style and conveniences of today. It is
located in the Excelsior neighborhood (a few steps to Persia Street) with great public
transportation including MUNI a few steps away and short distance to Balboa Park
BART station. Arteries to freeways 101 and 280 provide access to other areas of the
city or for commuting to the Peninsula or South Bay. Enjoy being close to McLaren
Park, Balboa Park and several other parks and playgrounds for outdoor activities.

This home boasts on the Main Level:
-Formal entry foyer with closet
-Formal living room with decorative fireplace, built-in cabinets, barrel style paned
front windows that bring in lots of light
-Formal dining room accessed from the living room through the beautiful French
style doors with beveled glass, the hallway or the kitchen
-Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, including: French style refrigerator, gas
stove with vented hood, dishwasher
-2 bedrooms; including the spacious primary suite with walk-in closet
-2 bathrooms; primary bathroom has stall shower and 2nd bathroom has shower
over tub
-Washer/dryer on this floor

On the Lower Level:
-2 bedrooms
-1 bathroom with stall shower
-Family room

Other details:
-Beautiful original hardwood floors with patterned details
-Original crown ceiling details
-Spacious backyard with 2 mature lemon trees and nice landscaping
-1 car garage

Pets not allowed
No smoking
Utilities: Tenant pays utilities

Rent $7200
Deposit $7200
Application fee $45

Listing Agent:
Eugenia "Genie" Mantzoros, Realtor and Luxury Leasing Agent
CalDRE #00805386

For Viewing Schedule:
Fritzie Anfone
